w5Mentions.name: The Nielsen
w5Mentions.firstLine: ◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
firstContext: 📺 SYSTEM: "EVERYONE. SIT. WATCH. The teeth and the weather can WAIT — nothing out there matters until this is done. ...Did I stutter? SIT."
◈ ABILITY — Dreadfield: The room feels you before you speak. Alien-terror starts at 2.
◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
◈ ABILITY — Oathbound: Your terror is pledged as a shield: your own people's horror grows half as fast.
◈ ABILITY — Shieldbearer: Spend terror to calm horror — the shield, not the sword. (Offered in the final beat.)

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: "Stonebridge is eating bark and calling it dinner," Priya says. "We left before we started looking at each other like food."
They're named, every one: Priya Hassan, Ibrahim Baker, June Petrov. Your move — ask them questions (up to three), call a MOOT on it, or turn them away at the edge of the firelight.
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. You went to bed on an empty stomach.
You camp wild tonight — no pantry meal. Eat from your pack.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (15/12/8), with 4 wave-4 fought, 8 contests survived, 5 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices.
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; promises kept. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Jorge Silva ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

◈ THE PANTHEON — Marcus Webb and Jorge Silva ascended together, and gods, it turns out, have politics. They argue about you the way the living argue about weather. Mostly, they agree: the village comes first. Mostly.
